Stage: validate — GitOps update1. Vault JWT → DB_PASSWORD, WP_AUTH_KEY, WP_SECURE_AUTH_KEY…
2. yq → values.yaml : .wordpress.image.tag = $SHA
3. git push (GIT_PUSH_TOKEN) → HEAD:branch [skip ci]
4. helm lint / helm template validation
→ commit déclenche sync ArgoCD
